intent: Task completion as a bar from 0 to 100. One piece. Optional label and percent.
useWhen: A determinate percent in a form, card, or page
doNotUseWhen: A spinner with no known percent — not this component
A rating out of 5 — that stays a Cell type

size.note: Track height. sm is space-1, md is space-2.

label.note: Visible name above the track. Prefer this over ProgressLabel.

showValue.note: Shows the rounded percent opposite the label. Prefer this over ProgressValue.

ariaLabel.note: Required when label is omitted. Cell passes the percent or its label.

requirements: Visible label uses aria-labelledby; unlabeled needs ariaLabel

doNot: Do not invent ProgressLabel, ProgressValue, ProgressTrack, ProgressIndicator, or ProgressRoot
Do not use a native progress element
Do not add indeterminate, circular, or extra tones yet
